segments.he:
א.

אֵין תְּקוּמָה בְּמִלְחָמָה עַל־יְדֵי הַעֲבָרַת הַשְּׁבוּעָה.
segments.en: Through mockery comes suffering.

segments.he:
ב.

מִי שֶׁרוֹדֵף אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ, הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מֵבִיא עָלָיו רָעָה, כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּשְׁכַּח אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ מִלִּרְדּוֹף אוֹתוֹ.
segments.en: Through m ockery he does not have wisdom.

segments.he:
ג.

עַל־יְדֵי קְרִיאַת הַלֵּל יוֹשִׁיעַ לְךָ הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מֵאוֹיְבֶיךָ.
segments.en: Mockery makes a person loathsome to G-d and to people.

segments.he:
ד.

עַל־יְדֵי כְּבוֹד הַתּוֹרָה אָדָם נִצּוֹל מִשּׂוֹנְאָיו.
segments.en: Through mockery come fires  (lit. burning) .

segments.he:
ה.

קֹדֶם הַמִּלְחָמָה צָרִיךְ תְּפִלָּה לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ.
segments.en: One who mocks the  words of the Sages is judged  (sentenced to be committed)  in boiling excrement.

segments.he:
ו.

בְּכָל פַּעַם שֶׁאָדָם נוֹפֵל מֵאֱמוּנָתוֹ, הוּא מַמְשִׁיךְ עָלָיו מִתְנַגֵּד גָּדוֹל וְעָשִׁיר.
segments.en: All forms of mockery are forbidden, except for the mocking of idol-worship.

segments.he:
ז.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם מִתְפַּלֵּל עַל שׂוֹנְאָיו, יִתְפַּלֵּל בַּבֹּקֶר.
segments.en: Mockery is a dreadful matter – for it begins with suffering and its end is annihilation.

segments.he:
ח.

הִסְתַּכְּלוּת בְּכָל פַּעַם עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם זֶהוּ מְבַטֵּל שִׂנְאַת הָאוֹיְבִים.
segments.en: One who mocks, his sustenance is diminished, and he falls into Hell, and he brings destruction to the world.

segments.he:
ט.

כְּשֶׁשּׁוֹכֵחַ אֶת הָעֲנִיִּים אֵין מְנַצֵּחַ.
segments.en: There is no maintaining a stand in war as a result of the transgression of an oath.

segments.he:
י.

עָנִי – שֶׁהָרָשָׁע רוֹדֵף אוֹתוֹ, תֵּדַע שֶׁהוּא בַּעַל־גַּאֲוָה.
segments.en: One who pursues his fellow-man  (to attack or harm him) , G-d brings evil upon him  (the pursuer)  in order that he will forget his fellow man from pursuing him.

segments.he:
יא.

מִי שֶׁהוּא נַצְחָן, הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא שׁוֹכֵחַ אוֹתוֹ וּמַסְתִּיר פָּנָיו מִמֶּנּוּ.
segments.en: Through the recitation of  Hallel (six specific chapters of  Tehillim  traditionally recited together on certain holidays)  the Holy Blessed One will save you from your enemies.

segments.he:
יב.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם מֵצֵר, אוֹיְבָיו נִתְרוֹמְמִים.
segments.en: Through giving honor to the Torah, a man is saved from those who hate him.

segments.he:
יג.

מִי שֶׁהוּא נַצְחָן, בָּא לִידֵי שִׁכְחָה.
segments.en: Before engaging in war, it is necessary to pray to the Blessed G-d.

segments.he:
יד.

מְרִיבָה בָּא לָאָדָם כְּשֶׁבָּא לָאָדָם אֵיזֶהוּ מִצְוָה וְהוּא מְשַׁלְּחָהּ וְאֵינוֹ מְקַיְּמָהּ.
segments.en: Each time that a person falls from his faith, he draws upon himself a rich and powerful adversary.

segments.he:
טו.

מִי שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה מְרִיבָה עִם הַצַּדִּיקִים, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁמַּחְשְׁבוֹתָיו רָעִים.
segments.en: When a person prays about his enemies, he should pray in the morning.

segments.he:
טז.

לִפְעָמִים הַמָּקוֹם גּוֹרֵם מְרִיבָה לָאָדָם.
segments.en: Gazing frequently at the heavens, this annuls the hatred of one's enemies.

segments.he:
יז.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שׂוֹנְאִים יַכְנִיעַ אֶת עַצְמוֹ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה יַצִּילֵהוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מִשּׂוֹנְאָיו.
segments.en: When one forgets the poor, he does not triumph.

segments.he:
יח.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לָאָדָם שׂוֹנְאִים, וְהוּא מְחַפֵּשׂ בְּכָל מִינֵי חִפּוּשׂ לִמְצֹא לָהֶם אַהֲבָה, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה יִהְיוּ כְּאֶפֶס וּכְאַיִן.
segments.en: A poor man that is pursued by an evil man, know that the poor man is arrogant.

segments.he:
יט.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לָאָדָם אוֹיְבִים, וְאֵינוֹ חוֹשֵׁב אֵיךְ לִנְקֹם בָּהֶם אֶלָּא, הוּא דָּבוּק בְּשִׂמְחַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא נוֹתֵן לּוֹ כֹּחַ לִנְקֹם מֵהֶם.
segments.en: One who is obsessed with winning, the Holy Blessed One forgets him and hides  His face from him .

segments.he:
כ.

הַנּוֹאֲפִים – לָרֹב הֵם בַּעֲלֵי מְרִיבָה לַצַּדִּיקִים.
segments.en: When a person is in distress, his enemies rise.

segments.he:
כא.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ הַכְנָעָ ה, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה אֵין מוֹרָא בּ ַ מִלְחָמָה. כְּאִלּוּ הוּא יוֹשֵׁב בְּמָצוֹר.
segments.en: One who is obsessed with winning comes to forgetfu lness .

segments.he:
כב.

מִי שֶׁהוּא נַצְחָן, בָּא עָלָיו חֳלָאִים לְאֵין מַרְפֵּא.
segments.en: Contention befalls a person when the person is presented with the opportunity to do a  Mitzvah , and he dismisses it and does not perform it.

segments.he:
כג.

שְׁנַיִם שֶׁמְּרִיבִים וְהוֹלְכִים לָדוּן לִפְנֵי הַשַׂר שֶׁל עַכּ וּ"ם, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה הַקָּדוֹשׁ־ בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מֵבִיא עֲלֵיהֶם מַכָּה, שֶׁאֵין לָהּ רְפוּאָה.
segments.en: One who quarrels with the  Tzaddikim , it is certain that his thoughts are evil.

segments.he:
כד.

לִפְעָמִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מְחַזֵּק לֵב הָרְשָׁעִים כְּנֶגֶד הַצַּדִּיקִים בִּמְרִיבָה, כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לָהֶם מַפָּלָה.
segments.en: Sometimes  the  location causes a person contention.

segments.he:
כה.

מִי שֶׁנּוֹתֵן כָּבוֹד לְזָקֵן, הוּא נִצּוֹל מִמִּלְחָמָה.
segments.en: Someone who has enemies should humble himself, and through this G-d will save him from his enemies.

segments.he:
כו.

מִי שֶׁמַּגִּיד רִיבוֹ לִפְנֵי הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא, רוֹאֶה נִקְמָתוֹ בְּשׂוֹנְאָיו.
segments.en: When a person has enemies, and he searches in all sorts of ways to find  (a way to)  love them, through this they will be as absolutely nothing.

segments.he:
כז.

עַל־יְדֵי הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת בָּא דַּלּוּת.
segments.en: When a person has enemies and he does not think of how to take revenge against them, but remains bound to the joy of the Blessed G-d, through this the Holy Blessed One gives him the power to avenge himself against them.

segments.he:
כח.

מִי שֶׁחוֹלֵק עִם שְׁכֵנָיו, לְסוֹף שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לַעַג לְאוֹיְבָיו.
segments.en: Those who sin sexually, for the most part, are fighters with  (i.e. against)  the  Tzaddikim .

segments.he:
כט.

מִי שֶׁשּׁוֹמֵעַ חֶרְפָּתוֹ וְשׁוֹתֵק, נִקְרָא חָסִיד, וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא שׁוֹמֵר אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ.
segments.en: When there  is [the trait of]  yielding  (humility),  through this there is no fear at war, as if he is dwelling in an impregnable fortress.

segments.he:
ל.

הַתְּפִלָּה בְּהִתְלַהֲבוּת עַד שֶׁהַהִתְלַהֲבוּת בָּא לוֹ בַּפָּנִים, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נוֹפְלִים וְנִתְלַהֲטִים שׂוֹנְאָיו.
segments.en: One who is obsessed with winning is visited with incurable illnesses.

segments.he:
לא.

מִי שֶׁהוּא טוֹב וְיָשָׁר מִנְּעוּרָיו, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ אֵיזֶה מַחֲלֹקֶת, יִתְנַדְּבוּ לִבָּם שֶׁל הַרְבֵּה בְּנֵי־אָדָם וְיִתְחַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו לַעֲזוֹר לוֹ.
segments.en: Two who are quarreling and take their case before a gentile dignitary, through this the Holy Blessed One brings upon them a blow that cannot be healed.

segments.he:
לב.

מִי שֶׁמֵּסִית וּמוֹנֵעַ אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ מִדֶּרֶךְ הַטּוֹב, אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לָקוּם נֶגֶד אוֹיְבָיו בִּשְׁעַת מְרִיבָה וּמִלְחָמָה.
segments.en: Sometimes, the Holy One, Blessed be He, hardens the heart of the wicked in contention against the righteous in order that [the wicked] have a downfall.

segments.he:
לג.

עַל־יְדֵי וִדּוּי יִתְבַּטֵּל מֵעָלֶיךָ מַחְשְׁבוֹת שׂוֹנְאֶיךָ.
segments.en: One who gives honor to an elderly man is saved from war.

segments.he:
לד.

הַבַּעַל־מַחֲלֹקֶת ,  בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁהוּא אוֹהֵב פֶּשַׁע.
segments.en: One who recounts his quarrel before the Holy One, Blessed be He, sees his vengeance on his enemies.

segments.he:
לה.

מִי שֶׁהוּא עָצוּר בְּמִלִּין, לֹא יוּכַל אוֹתוֹ שׁוּם אָדָם.
segments.en: Through strife comes poverty.

segments.he:
לו.

כְּשֶׁמִּתְנַגְּדִים חוֹלְקִים עַל חֲסִידִים וְרוֹצִים לְבַטֵּל אוֹתָם מִמְּלֶאכֶת־שָׁמַיִם, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נוֹפְלִים וְנִבְזִים בְּעֵינֵי עַצְמָן.
segments.en: One who quarrels with his neighbors ends up being an object of ridicule to his enemies.

segments.he:
לז.

לְנִצָּחוֹן תֹּאמַר קַפִּיטְל "עַל הַשְּׁמִינִית".
segments.en: One who is denigrated and remains silent is called pious and the Holy One, Blessed be He, guards his soul.

segments.he:
לח.

מִי שֶׁמְּבַקֵּר אֶת הַחוֹלֶה, הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא אֵינוֹ מוֹסֵר אוֹתוֹ בְּיַד שׂוֹנְאָיו.
segments.en: Fiery prayer, so fired up that it comes to his face, through this his enemies fall and are singed.

segments.he:
לט.

מִי שֶּׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שׂוֹנְאִים יֹאמַר כָּל הַיּוֹם תְּפִלּוֹת וּבַקָּשׁוֹת וְאַל יִפְסֹק פִּיו מִתְּפִלּוֹת וּבַקָּשׁוֹת, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה יוֹשִׁיעַ לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא וְאוֹיְבָיו יֵבוֹשׁוּ.
segments.en: One who is good and upright from his youth, through this, when he has a conflict, many people will volunteer and band together with him to help him.

segments.he:
מ.

מִי שֶׁהוּא נִרְדָּף, יִזְכֶּה לְבָנִים וּבְנֵי בָּנִים.
segments.en: One who  seduces  his fellow man and bars him from the good path, cannot stand up against his enemies in the time of contention and war.

segments.he:
מא.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שׂוֹנְאִים, יְבַקֵּשׁ רַבִּים, שֶׁיְּבַקְשׁוּ עָלָיו רַחֲמִים, וְיִהְיֶה לוֹ שָׁלוֹם מִן הַשּׂוֹנְאִים.
segments.en: Through confession, the thoughts of your enemies directed against you will be annulled.

segments.he:
מב.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לְךָ שׂוֹנְאִים לְמַטָּה, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁיֵּשׁ לְךָ שׂוֹנְאִים לְמַעְלָה.
segments.en: A contentious person, it  is certain that he likes sin  (crime) .

segments.he:
מג.

עַל־יְדֵי לִמּוּד הַשּׂוֹנְאִים יָשׁוּבוּ אָחוֹר.
segments.en: One who is reti cent, no man can overcome him  (compete with him) .

segments.he:
מד.

עַל־יְדֵי בִּטָּחוֹן לֹא יוּכְלוּ הַשּׂוֹנְאִים לְהָרַע לְךָ.
segments.en: When those opposed  [to Chassidus -  an approach to Jewish observance brought into the world by the holy Ba’al Shem Tov and his students]  oppose  chassidim  and want to arrest them from their devotions of Heaven, through this they fall and become despicable in their own eyes.

segments.he:
מה.

עַל־יְדֵי הַכְנָעָה יִפְּלוּ הַשּׂוֹנְאִים בַּמְּצוּדָה, שֶׁהֵכִינוּ לְךָ.
segments.en: For victory, say the chapter(s)  (which opens) , "On the eight-stringed instrument..."  (Psalms 6 and 12)

segments.he:
מו.

מִי שֶׁמִּתְפַּלֵּל כָּל הַיּוֹם, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּא בּוּשָׁה עַל אוֹיְבָיו.
segments.en: One who visits the sick, the Holy One, Blessed be He, does not hand him over to his enemies.

segments.he:
מז.

מִי שֶׁהֵרַע לְשׂוֹנְאוֹ שֶׁל הַצַּדִּיק, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה יִזְכֶּה לְנַצֵּחַ תָּמִיד.
segments.en: One who has enemies should say prayers and petitions all day, and his mouth should not cease from prayer and supplication, through this the Holy One, Blessed be He, will save him, and his enemies will be shamed  (see also 46) .

segments.he:
מח.

כְּשֶׁבְּנֵי־אָדָם דּוֹבְרִים עָלֶיךָ, תִּלְמַד בְּכָל לַיְלָה אַגָּדָה.
segments.en: One who is pursued will merit having children and grandchildren.

segments.he:
מט.

שְׁנֵי צַדִּיקִים אֵינָם יְכוֹלִים לָדוּר בְּעִיר אַחַת, עַד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לָהֶם אֱמֶת.
segments.en: One who has enemies should request of many people that they pray for mercy for him, and he will have peace from his enemies.

segments.he:
נ.

עַל־יְדֵי בִּטָּחוֹן אוֹיְבָיו לֹא יִשְׂמְחוּ בְּצָרָתוֹ.
segments.en: When you have enemies below  (in this world) , it is certain that you also have enemies Above  (in the Upper World) .

segments.he:
נא.

מִי שֶׁאֵין מְבַיֵּשׁ פְּנֵי חֲבֵרוֹ, לֹא יִשְׂמְחוּ אוֹיְבָיו עָלָיו.
segments.en: Through learning [Torah], one's enemies retreat.

segments.he:
נב.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ הַרְבֵּה שׂוֹנְאִים, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁהַשִּׂנְאָה שֶׁלֹּא כַּדִּין, כִּי אִי אֶפְשָׁר שֶׁיֵּצְאוּ כֻּלָּם יְדֵי חוֹבָתוֹ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ.
segments.en: By having trust, enemies will not be able to harm you.

segments.he:
נג.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לָאָדָם שׂוֹנְאִים, וְאַחַר־כָּךְ קָם עָלָיו אִישׁ אֶחָד מֵרֵעָיו וַאֲנָשָׁיו גַּם הוּא לַחֲלֹק עָלָיו, הוּא סִימָן שֶׁהַבַּעֲלֵי־מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁלּוֹ יִהְיוּ נִכְשָׁלִים וְנוֹפְלִים.
segments.en: By having [the trait of] submission, your enemies will fall into the trap that they prepared for you.

segments.he:
נד.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ אֱמוּנָה, אֵינוֹ יָרֵא מֵאוֹיְבִים.
segments.en: One who prays all day – through this shame comes upon his enemies (see also above 39).

segments.he:
נה.

עַל־יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה בְּשַׁוְעָה אוֹיְבָיו אֵינָם שְׂמֵחִים עָלָיו.
segments.en: One who harms (lit. did bad to) the enemy of a  Tzaddik  will merit to always triumph.

segments.he:
נו.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שׂוֹנְאִים, וְאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ אִם יִפֹּל בְּיָדָם אִם לָאו, יִסְתַּכֵּל אִם נוֹפֵל מִמַּדְרֵגַת עֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה נִמְסָר בְּיָדָם.
segments.en: When people speak bad about you, learn Agaddah (legends of the Oral Torah) every night (t.n. see superiority #30) .

segments.he:
נז.

לְמַחֲלֹקֶת יִלְמַד מַסֶּכֶת סֻכָּה.
segments.en: Two  T zaddikim  cannot live in the same city, until they have truth.

segments.he:
נח.

מַחֲלֹקֶת בָּא עַל־יְדֵי חֲבוּרַת רְשָׁעִים.
segments.en: Through having trust [in G-d], one's enemies will not rejoice in one's troubles.

segments.he:
נט.

עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת גַּם הָאוֹהֲבִים יַחְלְקוּ עָלֶיךָ.
segments.en: One who does not humiliate his fellow man, his enemies will not rejoice over him.

segments.he:
ס.

אֵין מְרִיבָה מְצוּיָה בְּבֵיתוֹ אֶלָּא עַד שֶׁתִּכְלֶה תְּבוּאָה מִבֵּיתוֹ.
segments.en: One who has many enemies, it is certain that their hatred is not justified. For it is impossible that they are all vindicated in his wronging them.

segments.he:
סא.

לִפְעָמִים כְּשֶׁהַרְבֵּה צַדִּיקִים חוֹלְקִים עַל צַדִּיק אֶחָד גַּם הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מַסְכִּים עִמָּהֶם אַף שֶׁהָאֱמֶת עִם הַצַּדִּיק הָאֶחָד, וְהַצַּדִּיקִים מַמְשִׁיכִין אֶת רְצוֹן הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא עִמָּהֶם.
segments.en: When a man has enemies, and afterwards one of his own friends and comrades also rises against him, it is a sign that his opponents will stumble and fall.

segments.he:
סב.

הַקּוֹרֵא לַחֲבֵרוֹ רָשָׁע, רַשַּׁאי לֵירֵד לְתוֹךְ אֻמָּנוּתוֹ וּלְמַעֵט מְזוֹנוֹתָיו עַד שְׁלִישׁ.
segments.en: One who has faith is not afraid from enemies.

segments.he:
סג.

אִם אֵין לָאָדָם חֲבֵרִים וְאוֹהֲבִים, נֹחַ לוֹ שֶׁיָּמוּת.
segments.en: Through prayer - crying out from pain, one's enemies will not rejoice over him.

segments.he:
סד.

כָּל הַדְּבָרִים נִבְרָאִים בִּבְחִינַת זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה ,  אֲפִלּוּ מְלָכִים :  יֵשׁ מֶלֶךְ בְּחִינַת זָכָר וְיֵשׁ מֶלֶךְ בְּחִינַת נְקֵבָה, וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מַרְחִיקָן זֶה מִזֶּה כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יַחֲרִיבוּ אֶת הָעוֹלָם.
segments.en: One who has enemies and does not know whether or not he will fall into their hands, should examine whether he falls from his level in service of the Blessed G-d, then it is certain he will be delivered  into their hands .

segments.he:
סה.

בַּעַל־מְרִיבָה – אַף־עַל־פִּי שֶׁהוּא לַמְדָן, אַל תְּכַבֵּד אוֹתוֹ.
segments.en: For [abating] contention, learn the Tractate Sukkah.

segments.he:
סו.

בִּמְקוֹם מְרִיבָה שָׁם הַשָּׂטָן.
segments.en: Contention comes through an association of evildoers.

segments.he:
סז.

מִי שֶׁמְּקַיֵּם קְרִיאַת־שְׁמַע שַׁחֲרִית וְעַרְבִית, אֵינוֹ נִמְסָר בְּיַד שׂוֹנְאָיו.
segments.en: Due to depression, even your friends will oppose you.

segments.he:
סח.

עַל־יְדֵי  תּוֹרָה  וּגְמִילוּת־חֲסָדִים  אוֹיְבָיו  נוֹפְלִים לְפָנָיו.
segments.en: Contention is not found  (prevalent)  in one's home only when all the produce in the house has been consumed.

segments.he:
סט.

עַל־יְדֵי רְדִיפָה הַנִּרְדָּף נִכְשָׁר לְקָרְבָּן לִפְנֵי אֱלֹקִים.
segments.en: Sometimes, when many  T zaddikim oppose one  Tzaddik , the Holy One, Blessed be He sides with them, even though the truth rests with the one  Tzaddik . the other  T zaddikim draw the Will of G-d to them.

segments.he:
ע.

לְעוֹלָם תְּצַדֵּד לְהַצִּיל אֶת הַנִּרְדָּפִים.
segments.en: One who calls his fellow man wicked, it is permitted to interfere with his business and to decrease his income by up to one third.

segments.he:
עא.

אֵין הָעוֹלָם מִתְקַיֵּם אֶלָּא בִּשְׁבִיל מִי שֶׁבּוֹלֵם אֶת פִּיו בִּשְׁעַת מְרִיבָה.
segments.en: If a person does not have friends and those who love him, death would be relief for him.

segments.he:
עב.

מִי שֶׁשּׁוֹכֵחַ דָּבָר אֶחָד מִתַּלְמוּדוֹ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה קָמִים עָלָיו בַּעֲלֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת.
segments.en: All things are created in the aspect  of male and female. Even kings -  there is a king whose aspect is male, and there is a king whose aspect is female. The Holy One, Blessed be He distances them from each other, that they should not come to destroy the world.

segments.he:
עג.

עַל־יְדֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁחוֹלְקִין עַל הַצַּדִּיק, נִתְעוֹרְרִים מִלְחָמוֹת.
segments.en: One who is contentious, even if he is an intellectual  (knows how to study Torah) , do not honor him.

segments.he:
עד.

כְּשֶׁדּוֹבְרִים עַל הָאָדָם, אֲזַי יֵשׁ כֹּחַ בַּיֵּצֶר הָרָע לְהַגְבִּיר אֶת עַצְמוֹ עַל זֶה הָאָדָם, שֶׁדּוֹבְרִים עָלָיו, וְצָרִיךְ לְבַקֵּשׁ רַחֲמִים עַל זֶה.
segments.en: In the place of contention; there is the Satan.

segments.he:
עה.

מִי שֶׁקָּשֶׁה לְקַבֵּל פִּיּוּס, הוּא מֵעָלְמָא דְּנוּקְבָא.
segments.en: One who fulfills  (the commandment)  to recite the Shma; every morning and night, will not be handed over to his enemies.

segments.he:
עו.

לִמְרִיבָה, הַשְׁכֵּם וְהַעֲרֵב לְבֵית־הַמִּדְרָשׁ וּלְמַד תּוֹרָה. אוֹ כְּשֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לָדוּן אוֹתָם, תִּתְפַּלֵּל עֲלֵיהֶם וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא יַפִּילֵם, וְאַל תִּמְסֹר אוֹ תָם לַשּׂ ַ ר.
segments.en: Through [learning] Torah and performing kindnesses, one's enemies fall before him.

segments.he:
עז.

כָּל שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ קִנְאָה עַל חֲבֵרוֹ וְדוֹמֵם, הַקָּדוֹשׁ־ בָּרוּךְ־הוּא עוֹשֶׂה לוֹ דִּין.
segments.en: Through being pursued, a person becomes fit to be a sacrificial offering before G-d.

segments.he:
עח.

אַל תָּרִיב עִם אָדָם שֶׁהוּא  תַּקִּיף  מִמְּךָ, אַף־עַל־פִּי
segments.en: One should always sid e to save those being pursued  (attacked).

segments.he:
עט.

שֶׁהוּא מֵכֵף אוֹת ְךָ לְדָבָר בִּלְתִּי הָגוּן. א ֲ בָל אִם יֵשׁ לוֹ אֵימַת שַׂר, תֵּלֵךְ עִמּוֹ אֶל הַשַּׁר וְאַל תַּעֲשֶׂה הַדָּבָר בִּלְתִּי הָגוּן.
segments.en: The world would not continue to exist except for the sake of one who shuts his mouth at the time of contention.

segments.he:
פ.

עַל־יְדֵי לָשׁוֹן הָרָע נוֹפְלִים בַּמִּלְחָמָה.
segments.en: One who forgets one detail from his learning causes antagonists to rise against him.

segments.he:
פא.

מִי שֶׁאֵין אוֹמֵר לָשׁוֹן הָרָע, הוּא מְנַצֵּחַ.
segments.en: Through strife, that there is opposition on the  Tzaddik , wars are aroused.

segments.he:
פב.

שָׁנָה וּפֵרֵשׁ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה אוֹיְבָיו רוֹדְפִין אוֹתוֹ.
segments.en: When [people] speak about a person, the evil inclination has power to strengthen himself over that person, and one must pray for mercy about this.

segments.he:
פג.

כְּשֶׁאִשְׁתּוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם שׁוֹפַעַת דָּם בְּלֹא עֵת נִדָּתָהּ, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁאֵיזֶה שִׂנְאָה נִתְעוֹרֵר עָלָיו.
segments.en: One who has difficulty accepting appeasement is from the feminine world.

segments.he:
פד.

כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיק יֵשׁ לוֹ מַחֲלֹקֶת עִם אֶחָד וְיָכוֹל לְהַצִּיל אֶת עַצְמוֹ עִם מָמוֹן, יַצִּיל אֶת עַצְמוֹ וְאַל יִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בְּצִדְקָתוֹ.
segments.en: For contention; go early and stay late in the hall of study and learn Torah. Or ,  if it is impossible to bring those opposing  you to judgment [in a Beis  Din  -  Jewish court], pray about them, and the Holy One, Blessed be He, will knock them down, but do not hand them over to a  (non-Jewish)  official .

segments.he:
פה.

בְּכָל בַּעֲלֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת נִתְגַּלְגְּלִים שָׁם נִיצוֹצִין מִנִּשְמַת דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם.
segments.en: One who has cause to retaliate against his friend and remains silent about it, the Holy One, Blessed be He, does justice for him.

segments.he:
פו.

הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁיֵּשׁ בֵּין שְׁנֵי צַדִּיקִים לְטוֹבַת יִשְׂרָאֵל, תֵּדַע שֶׁגַּם לְמַעְלָה יֵשׁ שְׁנֵי מַלְאָכִים שֶׁגַּם הֵם חוֹלְקִים גַּם־כֵּן, וְאֵין לָהֶם מַכְרִיעַ אֶלָּא הַקָּדוֹשׁ־ בָּרוּךְ־הוּא בְּעַצְמוֹ.
segments.en: Do not contend with a man who  is  stronger  than  you,

segments.he:
פז.

מִי שֶׁשּׁוֹמֵעַ חֶרְפָּתוֹ וְשׁוֹתֵק, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נִתְבַּטֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ רַבּוֹת רָעוֹת שֶׁהָיוּ רְאוּיִין לָבוֹא עָלָיו.
segments.en: even though he drives you to do something dishonorable. However, if he has fear of the governor, go with him to an official, and do not do the dishonorable thing.

segments.he:
פח.

דַּעְתּוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא נוֹטָה תָּמִיד אַחַר הָרֹב, אֲבָל אִם הָרֹב הֵם רְשָׁעִים, אֵין דַּעְתּוֹ נוֹטָה אַחֲרֵיהֶם.
segments.en: Through evil speech  (tale bearing) , ther e  are  lo s ses  (fallen )  in war.

segments.he:
פט.

אֵין מְלַמְּדִין זְכוּת עַל הַמֵּסִית.
segments.en: One who refrains from speaking slander  (tale bearing - lit. evil language)  triumphs.

segments.he:
צ.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ מַחֲלֹקֶת מִשְּׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים, וּלְכָל אֶחָד יֵשׁ לוֹ אֲנָשִׁים הַמְצַדְּדִים לוֹ, כּ ְשֶׁגּוֹזְרִים מִיתָה לְמַעְלָה  חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, עַל אֶחָד מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת, מַתְחִילִין מִן הַקָּטָן שֶׁבָּהֶם ,  וְלֹא מִן הָאִיש שֶׁהוּא עִקָּר בַּמַּחֲלֹקֶת.
segments.en: One who [was accustomed] to review [Torah] and then separated  (ceasing his study of the Torah) , through this his enemies will pursue him.

segments.he:
צא.

לִפְעָמִים נִגְזָר עַל הָאָדָם, שֶׁיִּכְלֶה זַרְעוֹ. וּכְשֶׁנִּמְסָר בְּיַד שׂוֹנְאָיו, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נִתְבַּטֵּל הַגְּזֵרָה שֶׁל כְּלָיַת זַרְעוֹ.
segments.en: When a man's wife bleeds outside of the time of her period, it is certain that some hatred has been aroused against him.

segments.he:
צב.

מִי שֶׁמַּרְחִיק אֶת הָאָדָם מֵעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה יָבוֹא מִמֶּנּוּ זֶרַע, שֶׁיְּצַעֲרוּ לְזַרְעוֹ שֶׁל הַמַּרְחִיק.
segments.en: When the  Tzaddik  has a conflict with someone and can save himself through monetary means, he should  save himself ,  and  not  use his merits  (lit. righteousness) .

segments.he:
צג.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּיָדוֹ לִמְחוֹת בָּרְשָׁעִים וְלֹא מִחָה, כְּאִלּוּ הוּא עוֹשֶׂה הָרָע.
segments.en: In all perpetrators of conflict, there are sparks from the souls of Dusun and Aviram.

segments.he:
צד.

הַמַּחֲזִיק בַּמַּחֲלֹקֶת, עוֹבֵר בְּלָאו וְרָאוּי לְהִצְטָרֵעַ.
segments.en: Conflict between two  tzaddikim  is for the good of the Jewish People: Know that this is true ,  for also Above, there are two angels who are also in conflict, and there is no one to adjudicate for them except for the Holy One, Blessed be He, Himself.

segments.he:
צה.

הַחוֹלֵק עַל מַלְכוּת בֵּית־דָּוִד, רָאוּי לְהַכִּישׁוֹ נָחָשׁ.
segments.en: One who hears his degradation and remains silent through this great evils that were fit to come upon him are nullified.

segments.he:
צו.

עַל־יְדֵי עֵסֶק הַתּוֹרָה יָכוֹל לַעֲמֹד בְּקִשְׁרֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה.
segments.en: The Holy One, Blessed be He, always assumes a position in favor of the majority. However, if the majority is  [comprised of ]  evildoers, He does not favor them.

segments.he:
צז.

צָרִיךְ לְהִתְחַזֵּק נֶגֶד הַשּׂוֹנְאִים וּלְהַעֲרִיךְ עִמָּהֶם מִלְחָמָ ה בְּתַחְבּוּלָה , וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ־ בָּרוּךְ־הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָיו.
segments.en: One must not give the benefit of the doubt  (interpret his actions in a favorable manner)  to a seducer (someone who tries to bring people to foreign beliefs) .

segments.he:
צח.

לְמַחֲלֹקֶת סְגֻלָּה לוֹמַר: "וַיִּקְרָא אָסָא אֶל ה'" עַד "אֱנוֹשׁ"  (בְּדִבְרֵי־הַיָּמִים־ב יד,י) .
segments.en: When there is a conflict between two people, and each one has people taking his side; when from Above, death is decreed upon one of the disputants, G-d forbid,  it begins with the  (smallest)  least involved, and not with the person who is the main contender.

segments.he:
צט.

מִי שֶׁאֵין בִּטְחוֹנוֹ בֶּאֱלֹקָיו, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּאִים מִלְחָמוֹת וּמְרִיבוֹת.
segments.en: Sometimes it is decreed on a man that his seed will be wiped out. However, when he is delivered into his enemies' hands, the decree of the destruction of his seed is annulled.

segments.he:
ק.

עַל־יְדֵי לִמּוּד תּוֹרָה נוֹפֵל פַּחַד עַל הָאֻמּוֹת, שֶׁלֹּא יִלָּחֲמוּ עִם יִשְׂרָאֵל.
segments.en: 91 . One who distances a man from the service of the Blessed  G-d , through this  that man  will  have descendants who will afflict the descendants of the one who distanced him.

segments.he:
קא.

לְמַחֲלֹקֶת תֹּאמַר: "וַיֹּאמֶר ה' אֱלֹקֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ" עַד "כִּי עָלֶיךָ עֵינֵינוּ" מַה שֶׁאָמַר יְהוֹשָׁפָט  (בדברי הימים ב' כ') .
segments.en: One who has the ability to protest [the deeds of] the wicked and does not, it is as if he himself did the wrong.

segments.he:
קב.

בִּשְׁעַת מִלְחָמָה צָרִיךְ לְהָכִין כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה כַּנָּהוּג, וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה מַה שֶּׁבִּרְצוֹנוֹ, וְאֵין לִסְמוֹךְ עַל הַנֵּס.
segments.en: One who sustains a conflict transgresses a negative commandment ,  and it befits him to become a leper.

segments.he:
קג.

הַקּוֹבֵעַ מָקוֹם לִתְפִלָּתוֹ, אוֹיְבָיו נוֹפְלִים תַּחְתָּיו.
segments.en: One who challenges the Kingship of the House of David is fit to be bitten by a snake.

segments.he:
קד.

אֵין לְהִתְפַּלֵּל עַל שׁוּם אָדָם שֶׁיָּמוּת אֲפִלּוּ עַל מִין, כִּי יוֹתֵר טוֹב לַהֲרֹג אוֹתָם בִּידֵי אָדָם וְלֹא בִּידֵי שָׁמַיִם.
segments.en: Through being involved in studying Torah, one can withstand the vicissitudes of war.

segments.he:
קה.

אַל תִּתְגָּרֶה בְּרָשָׁע; כָּל שֶׁכֵּן בְּרָשָׁע שֶׁהַשָּׁעָה מְשַׂחֶקֶת לוֹ.
segments.en: One must strengthen oneself against those who hate him, and wage war upon them cunningly, and  [know that]  the Holy One, Blessed be He, will do what is right in His Eyes.

segments.he:
קו.

מֻתָּר שֶׁלֹּא לְהוֹדוֹת עַל הָאֱמֶת וְלַחֲלֹק עָלָיו, כְּדֵי דְּלָא לִטְעֵי כֻּלֵּי עַלְמָא בַּתְרֵהּ.
segments.en: In situations  of conflict, it is auspicious  ( segulah )  to say the passages, "And Asa called to G-d …” until “mortal."  (Chronicles II, 14:10) .

segments.he:
קז.

בַּעֲווֹן שִׂנְאַת־חִנָּם מְרִיבָה רַבָּה בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ.
segments.en: One who does not put his trust in G-d, through this he is confronted with war and conflict.

segments.he:
קח.

חֶרֶב וּבִזָּה רַבָּה בָּא בַּעֲווֹן עִנּוּי הַדִּין וְעִוּוּת וְקִלְקוּל הַדִּין וּבִטּוּל תּוֹרָה.
segments.en: Through the study of Torah, fear falls upon the nations that they do not wage war against Israel.

segments.he:
קט.

אִשָּׁה נִדָּה דְּפָסְקָה בֵּי ן תְּרֵי, אִם סוֹף נִדָּה הִיא עוֹשׂ ָ ה מְרִיבָה בֵּינֵיהֶם.
segments.en: In situations of conflict, say, "And he  (king Yehoshafat)  said, G-d of our forefathers,…” until “For our eyes are turned to You." What was said by Yehoshafat by Yehoshafat  (Chronicles  II, 20: 6-12) .

segments.he:
קי.

הַנִּרְדָּף שֶׁמְּפַיֵּס אֶת הָרוֹדֵף, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נִתְעוֹרֵר דִּין עַל הָרוֹדֵף.
segments.en: In a time of war, one must prepare the weapons of war appropriately, and the Holy One, Blessed be He, will do according to His Will, but do not rely on miracles.

segments.he:
קיא.

הַמְפַרְנֵס אֶת שׂוֹנְאָיו, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נִדּוֹן הַשּׂוֹנֵא בְּדִין שְׂרֵפָה.
segments.en: One who establishes a fixed place for his prayer, his enemies fall beneath him.

segments.he:
קיב.

חֵלֶק שֵׁנִי
segments.en: One should not pray for the death of any man, even an apostate. For it is better to kill them by mortal means, rather than by the Ha nd of Heaven .

segments.he:
קיג.

עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁדּוֹבְרִים עַל הַצַּדִּיק, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נִתְגַּבֵּר הַפִּילוֹסוֹפְיָא בָּעוֹלָם וְכֵן לְהֵפֶךְ.
segments.en: Do not provoke an evildoer, all the more so  (don't start up with)  one whose hour of fortune is at hand  (lit. the hour is laughing for him) .

segments.he:
קיד.

יֵשׁ מְפֻרְסָמִים שֶׁעִקַּר הַפִּרְסוּם שֶׁלָּהֶם נַעֲשָׂה עַל־יְדֵי הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת.
segments.en: It is permissible to not admit the truth, and  (even)  deny it, in order that people not be led astray after  [an evildoer] .

segments.he:
קטו.

עַל־יְדֵי הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת נוֹפֵל לְתַאֲוַת נִאוּף.
segments.en: Due to baseless hatred, a person will have great conflict in his house.

segments.he:
קטז.

מִי שֶׁקָּמִים עָלָיו רַבִּים וְחוֹלְקִים עָלָיו עַל אֱמוּנָתוֹ, וְהוּא עוֹמֵד כְּנֶגְדָּם וְטוֹעֵן כְּנֶגְדָּם דְבָרִים הַנִּתְקַבְּלִים, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה זוֹכֶה לְבָנִים רַבִּים וְהָעוֹלָם נִתְמַלֵּא מִזַּרְעוֹ.
segments.en: [Blows from]  a sword and great plundering come through the sin of procrastinating justice, distorting, and ruining judgment, and for neglect of Torah  [study] .

segments.he:
קיז.

מִי שֶׁנּוֹתֵן עֵינֵי שִׂכְלוֹ תָּמִיד לַחְקֹר אֶת רָאשֵׁי־הַדּוֹר וּמְעַיֵּן בָּהֶם בְּעֵינָא בִּישָׁא, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נוֹפֵל לְרָעָב שֶׁלֶּעָתִיד, הַיְנוּ לֹא רָעָב לַלֶּחֶם, וְזֶה "רָעָב" עַ'יִן בְּ'תוֹךְ רַ'ב.
segments.en: A woman at the end of her menstrual period who passes between two men causes strife between them.

segments.he:
קיח.

עַל־יְדֵי צְדָקָה בְּסִבָּה קַלָּה הוּא מַכְנִיעַ אֶת אוֹיְבָיו, וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מַצִּילוֹ מִסִּבּוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת שֶׁל אוֹיְבָיו.
segments.en: A pursued  (attacked)  person who placates the pursuer, through this harsh judgment is aroused upon the pursuer.

segments.he:
קיט.

עַל־יְדֵי בִּרְכַּת־הַמָּזוֹן נִתְוַדַּע הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בָּעוֹלָם. גַּם עַל־יְדֵי בִּרְכַּת־הַמָּזוֹן נִתְיַשֵּׁב הַמַּלְכוּת מִן הַמְּרִיבוֹת וְהַמִּלְחָמוֹת.
segments.en: One who gives sustenance to his enemy causes a decree of burning on the enemy.

segments.he:
קכ.

מִי שֶׁלִּמּוּדוֹ בַּתּוֹרָה בְּמֹחִין זַכִּים, שֶׁאֲכִילָתוֹ כָּל־כָּךְ בִּקְדֻשּ ָׁה, שֶׁנִּזּוֹן מִמָּזוֹן שֶׁהַמַּלְאָכִים נִזּוֹנִין מִמֶּנּוּ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה שׂוֹנְאָיו נִדּוֹנִין בְּחֶנֶק. וְסִימָן לַדָּבָר: "וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיוֹת הַבֹּקֶר"; "וּבַבֹּקֶר הָיְתָה שִׁכְבַת הַטָּל"; "וַיְהִי בְּאַשְׁמֹרֶת הַבֹּקֶר".
segments.en: SECOND PART :

segments.he:
121.

הַצַּעַר וְהַקִּנְטוּר שֶׁיֵּשׁ עַל הֶחָכָם, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּא לִידֵי שִׁכְחָה.
segments.en: Talking  (bad)  about a  Tzaddik  causes [heretical] philosophy to gain strength in the world, and so too, the op posite  [i.e. praising a  tzaddik  strengthens faith ].

segments.he:
122.

עַל־יְדֵי הַמְּרִיבָה גּוֹרְמִים, שֶׁהַתַּלְמִידִים הַקְּטַנִּים נִתְפַּרְסְמִים קֹדֶם זְמַנָּם, וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת הַפָּלַת נְפָלִים, שֶׁהַוָּלָד יוֹצֵא לַאֲוִיר הָעוֹלָם קֹדֶם זְמַנּוֹ, וְעַל־יְדֵי זֶה גּוֹרֵם עֲנִיּוּת וְלִפְעָמִים גּוֹרֵם מִיתוֹת, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם.
segments.en: There are famous religious leaders whose fame is primarily created through controversy.

segments.he:
123.

לִפְעָמִים אֵין שְׁלוֹם בַּיִת לָאָדָם וְכָל בְּנֵי־בֵיתוֹ בִּקְטָטָה, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁיֵּשׁ שֵׁדִים בַּבַּיִת הַגּוֹרְמִין כָּל זֶה, וְעַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּאִים יִסּוּרִים עַל אַנְשֵׁי בֵּיתוֹ.
segments.en: Through strife, one falls into sexual lust.

segments.he:
124.

לִפְעָמִים מְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם גּוֹרֵם לוֹ מְרִיבוֹת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאֵין שׁוֹאֲלִין בִּשְׁלוֹם חֲבֵרוֹ בִּמְקוֹם הַטִּנֹּפֶת.
segments.en: One against whom many arise to challenge him on account of his faith; and he stands up against them and makes well-received counter-claims, through this he will merit having many children, and the world will be filled with his seed.

segments.he:
125.

עַל־יְדֵי הַצַּעַר וְהָעַצְבוּת בָּא מְרִיבָה בָּעוֹלָם, וְעַל־יְדֵי הַשִׂמְחָה בָּא שָׁלוֹם בָּעוֹלָם.
segments.en: One who always sets his mind's eye to investigate the leaders of the generation, examining them unfavorably  (lit. with a “bad eye”) , through this he falls into the hunger predicted for the future, that is to say, "…not a hunger for bread…"  (Amos 8)  For the Hebrew word for hunger, Ra’AV, is the word  Ra V (denoting the head rabbi)  with the letter Ayin  (which is Hebrew for “eye”)  in the middle  ( Reish  and Beit  spell  Rav , and  Reish  -  Ayin  -  Beit  spell  hunger. [I.e. putting a (bad) eye on (in) the  Rav  leads to hunger,  Ra’AV .])

segments.he:
126.

הִתְגַּלּוּת הַתּוֹרָה הִיא עַל־יְדֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם.
segments.en: Through giving charity, one defeats his  enemies through minimal means  (cause or effect)  and the Holy One, Blessed be He, saves him from even the great means of his enemies.

segments.he:
127.

הַמַּשָּׂא־וּמַתָּן אוֹ הַמְּלָאכָה שֶׁאָדָם מְיַגֵּעַ בּוֹ בְּיוֹם תַּעֲנִיתוֹ, זֶה הַדָּבָר מַצִּיל אוֹתוֹ מִשּׂוֹנְאִים וּמֵרוֹצְחִים.
segments.en: By saying  Birkat HaMazon (the blessings after the meal which fulfill the Torah mandate, “You shall eat, be satisfied and bless the L-rd, your G-d…”),  the Blessed G-d becomes known in the world. Also through Grace After Meals, the government is rested from strife and war.

segments.he:
128.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שׂוֹנְאִים, קָשֶׁה לוֹ לְכַוֵּן דַּעְתֵּהּ בַּתְּפִלָּה.
segments.en: One who's Torah learning is with a pure mind, [including that his] eating is so holy that he is nourished from the [same] food from which the angels are nourished, causes that his enemies be punished with strangulation. A sign  (or hint to the veracity )  of this matter is:  (three similar Biblical phrases):  "And it was on the third day, at the beginning of the morning…”  (Shemot 19:16) , "And in the morning there was a layer of dew…”  (Shemot 16:13) " "And it was in the watch of the morning…”  (Shemot 14:24)

segments.he:
129.

מִי שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה פֵּרוּד בֵּין אִישׁ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ, הַיְנוּ שֶׁהוֹלֵךְ לָאִישׁ וּמְיַפֶּה אֶת הָאִשָׁה בִּפְנֵי הַבַּעַל, וְהוֹלֵךְ אֶל הָאִשָּׁה וּמְגַנֶּה אֶת בַּעְלָהּ בְּעֵינֶיהָ, עַד שֶׁ נַעֲשָׂה  פֵּרוּד בֵּינֵיהֶם, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה  נַעֲשָׂה  טָרוּד בִּמְזוֹנוֹתָיו.
segments.en: The suffering and accusations that come upon a Torah sage cause him to forget.

segments.he:
130.

כְּשֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא רוֹאֶה אֵיזֶה צַדִּיק, שֶׁיֵּשׁ כֹּחַ בְּיָדוֹ לְקָרֵב בְּנֵי־אָדָם לַעֲבוֹדָתוֹ, אֲזַי מַעֲמִיד עָלָיו שׂוֹנְאִים, כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לְקָרֵב בְּנֵי־אָדָם, כִּי הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁאֵין לוֹ שׂוֹנְאִים, אֵין יָכוֹל לְקָרֵב, כְּמוֹ בְּעֵת בִּיאַת הַמָּשִׁיחַ יֵשְׁבוּ בְּשַׁלְוָה, וְאָז אֵין מְקַבְּלִים גֵּרִים.
segments.en: Quarreling causes that students of small stature become famous before their time. T his is an aspect of miscarriage - when a fetus comes into the air of the world before its time. This causes poverty, and sometimes  (even)  causes deaths, G-d forbid.

segments.he:
131.

עַל־יְדֵי הִרְהוּרֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה שׂוֹנְאִים בָּאִים וְנִתְרוֹמְמִים עַל אָדָם.
segments.en: Sometimes a man does not have peace in his house, and all the members of his household quarrel with each other. It is certain that there are demon s in the house causing all this -  and th r ough this affliction comes upon his household.

segments.he:
132.

מִי שֶׁשּׂוֹנְאָיו נִתְרוֹמְמִים, הוּא נוֹפֵל לְתַאֲוַת אֲכִילָה.
segments.en: Sometimes a person's place causes him quarrels ,  for the same reason as it is forbidden to ask about a person's peace in an unclean place.  [The Hebrew word for peace, “shalom” is a Name of G-d and should not be spoken in a filthy place – thus we find that certain places are contrary to peace.]

segments.he:
133.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם מַרְגִּישׁ חִכּוּךְ בְּגוּפוֹ, יֵדַע שֶּׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שׂוֹנְאִים, וְלִפְעָמִים שֶׁעַל־יְדֵי מַכּוֹת וְחַבּוּרוֹת שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה בְּגוּפוֹ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נִצּוֹל מִשּׂוֹנְאִים, כִּי זֶה נִתְחַלֵּף בָּזֶה.
segments.en: Through pain and sadness, contention comes to the world.  [ Conversely ] , through joy, peace comes to the world.

segments.he:
134.

יֵשׁ שְׁנֵי צַדִּיקִים, שֶׁאֶחָד דִּבּוּרָיו הֵם בַּחֲרִישָׁה, וְהַשֵּׁנִי דְּבָרָיו בִּקְצִירָה, אוֹ אֶחָד דְּבָרָיו הֲקָמַת הַבְּרִית לְזִוּוּג, וְהַשֵּׁנִי דְּבָרָיו הֵם הַמַּמְשִׁיכִים אֶת הַזֶּרַע וּמְהַוִּים אֶת הַוָּלָד בְּבֶטֶן אִמּוֹ וּמְגַדְּלִין אוֹתוֹ. בְּכֵן כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ מַחֲלֹקֶת בֵּין שְׁנֵי צַדִּיקִים הָאֵלּוּ, אַל יִתְעָרֵב זָר בְּתוֹךְ דִּבּוּרִים, שֶׁמְּדַבְּרִים זֶה עַל זֶה, כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יְקַלְקֵל הַמְכֻוָּן.
segments.en: Revelation of the Torah comes through peace.

segments.he:
135.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שׂוֹנְאִים, יַזִּיר מִן הַיַּיִן, וְעַל־יְדֵי זֶה  נַעֲשָׂה  רֹאשׁ לָהֶם.
segments.en: The business or work that a man strains to do on a fast-day, this matter saves him from enemies and murderers.

segments.he:
136.

סְגֻלָּה לְהִנָּצֵל מִשּׂוֹנְאִים, הֵן שׂוֹנְאִים שֶׁל מַחֲלֹקֶת הֵן שׂוֹנְאִים שֶׁבַּדֶּרֶךְ, שֶׁמִּתְיָרֵא מֵהֶם, לוֹמַר כָּל הַטְּעָמִים שֶׁבַּתּוֹרָה, דְּהַיְנוּ פַּשְׁטָא מֻנַּח זַרְקָא וְכוּ'.
segments.en: One who has enemies has difficulty concentrating in prayer.

One who causes a separa tion between a man and his wife -  that is, he goes to the husband and glorifies the wife in his eyes, and then goes to the wife and discredits the husband in her eyes, until it causes a  separation between them -  causes difficulty with his own livelihood.

When the Holy One, Blessed be He, sees that there is a  Tzaddik  who has the power to draw people to the service of G-d, He raises up enemies against him inorder to enable him to draw people close  [to G-d].  For a  Tzaddik  without enemies cannot draw anyone close – just like in the days of the Messiah the world will dwell in tranquility, and then no new converts will be accepted.
Due to idolatrous thoughts enemies come and dominate  (lit. elevate over)  a person.
One whose enemies rise up  (against him)  falls into lust for food  .

When a person feels itching in his body, he should know that he has enemies. Sometimes through the blows and bruises he brings upon his own body, he is saved from enemies, for one is in exchange for the other.

There are two  T zaddikim , one of whose words are in plowing, and the other's in harvesting; or one whose words erect the the bris  (circumcision – a holy reference to the male covenant)  for relations, and the other's words draw the seed and create the fetus  in its mother's womb, and cultivate it. Thus, when there is an argument between these two  T zaddikim , an outsider should not involve himself in their words that they speak one on another, in order no to ruin the goal.
One who has enemies should prohibit himself from wine, and through this he will become their head

A  segulah to be saved from one's enem ies -  whether they are enemies in controversy or  enemies on the routes of travel -  of whom he is afraid; is to say all the names of the ta'amim  (incantation notes)  of the Torah -  that is:  Pashta ,  Munach ,  Zarkah , etc.
